title: Conditional Aggregation with CASE WHEN
realWorldScenario: Credit risk officers need to count how many loans are in good standing versus overdue across EMI installments.
questionStatement: Write a query on `emi_schedule` to calculate the total count of installments (`total_emis`), count of paid installments (`paid_count`), and count of overdue installments (`overdue_count`) using `CASE WHEN`.
starterCode:
-- Conditional aggregation on EMI installments
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_emis,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_count
FROM emi_schedule;
hints: In a CASE statement, evaluate WHEN status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, and wrap with SUM.
